statement: Let xCount(board) be the number of cells equal to 'X' and oCount(board) the number of cells equal to 'O'. A winning line for a character c is a row, column, or diagonal all of whose three cells equal c; say X wins if there is a winning line for 'X', and O wins if there is a winning line for 'O'. The function returns a result r, and r = true if and only if all of the following hold: (1) xCount(board) = oCount(board) or xCount(board) = oCount(board) + 1; (2) it is not the case that both X wins and O wins; (3) if X wins then xCount(board) = oCount(board) + 1; (4) if O wins then xCount(board) = oCount(board).
preconditions: len(board) = 3; for every i with 0 <= i < 3, len(board[i]) = 3; for every i, j with 0 <= i < 3 and 0 <= j < 3, board[i][j] is one of the bytes corresponding to ' ', 'X', or 'O'.
